control.tab: existing worker-0; independent persistent client; no extra browser tab
control.window: start with measured worker dispatch; stop after workers finish; include completion of an in-flight control in active wall time
control.secondary: control requests use the same 128 MiB admission reservation
control.timing: record scheduled/start/end monotonic timestamps; loaded latency includes admission and same-tab serialization; idle socket/CLI controls remain separately labeled
control.gate: every probe succeeds and candidate loaded-control p95 <=1.10*baseline; retain sample counts and raw values; do not infer loaded latency from idle controls

runtimeGrid.scope: candidate-only semantic phase outside performance windows; separate fresh profile at every level
runtimeGrid.ownership: one leased tab per actor, matching agent/task; reject a wrong-owner mutation and verify no mutation occurred
runtimeGrid.fairness: 3 rounds per actor, 50ms asynchronous owned eval increment; every actor completes3; deadline10seconds, maximum per-command latency5seconds; record progress order, time since own last completion and counters
runtimeGrid.cancellation: at every level: owned running wait false; queued mutation behind it; reject wrong-owner cancellation; cancel queued request by ID; cancel running wait by ID; verify cancellation results and zero mutation, then each owner can progress
runtimeGrid.resources: same 2048 MiB whole-family abort guard; preserve full per-level errors, ownership checks, cancellation receipts, fairness records, runtime metrics and cleanup; ineligible resource-aborted levels remain failures
